system.name: MathNet
system.one_liner: A global multimodal benchmark of 30K+ Olympiad-level math problems with expert solutions, a 68-type ontology and three evaluation tasks: comprehension, retrieval and RAG.

content.variant_note: a central wordmark with four colour-framed panels around it: data statistics (bubble chart, choropleth map, language list), solution drawings, a topic ontology, and three task flows with a model-logo strip
content.argues: MathNet is large (30,676 problems against at most 6,142 in earlier benchmarks), global, expertly solved, topically diverse and comes with three evaluation tasks and a leaderboard.
content.subject: Wordmark hub with panels for data scale and coverage, expert solutions, an ontology of 68 problem types, and three evaluation task flows with model logos.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give a benchmark a hub: the wordmark in the middle, one colour-framed panel per selling point, each titled in its own colour in the frame border and carrying its most convincing visual (bubble chart, map, solution diagrams, ontology cards, task flows).
lessons.suits: Dataset or benchmark papers that must sell scale, quality, coverage and evaluation protocol in one overview.

evidence: MATHNET contains 30K+ Olympiad-level problems across 47 countries, 17 languages, and 143 competitions over 40 years with expert-authored solutions.
We evaluate several leading models on problem solving and math-aware retrieval.
LLMs, MLLMs, and Embedding Models Leaderboard

summary: MathNet is a benchmark of 30,676 Olympiad-level math problems from 40+ countries in 17 languages, with expert-written multimodal solutions and an ontology of 68 problem types, used for three evaluation tasks. Figure 1 is a hub-style overview: the MathNet wordmark with a globe sits in the middle and four colour-framed panels hang around it. The left panel compares dataset sizes with a bubble chart (30,676 against seven earlier benchmarks), a choropleth world map of problem counts and a list of the 17 languages in their scripts; the top panel shows solution diagrams; the bottom panel stacks tilted ontology cards; the right panel gives three task flows (math comprehension, problem retrieval, math RAG) and a strip of model logos for the leaderboard.
summary_zh: MathNet 是含 30,676 道奥赛数学题、覆盖 40 多国 17 种语言的基准。图 1 以中央标志为枢纽，四个彩色圆角框分别展示数据规模（气泡图、地图、语言）、专家解答图、68 类题型本体，以及三种评测任务和模型徽标。
